+from app.api import handlers

+def test_handle_get_user_by_email_success():

+def test_handle_get_user_by_email_not_found():
+    params = {"email": "nonexistent@example.com"}
+    status, response = handlers.handle_get_user_by_email(params)
+    assert status == 404
+    assert response == {"error": "not found"}
+
+def test_handle_get_user_by_email_invalid():
+    # Test missing email
+    status, response = handlers.handle_get_user_by_email({})
+    assert status == 400
+    assert response == {"error": "invalid email"}
+    
+    # Test non-string email
+    status, response = handlers.handle_get_user_by_email({"email": 123})
+    assert status == 400
+    assert response == {"error": "invalid email"}
+    
+    # Test invalid format
+    status, response = handlers.handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "invalid-email"})
+    assert status == 400
+    assert response == {"error": "invalid email"}
